'''Premiere &ndash; Dagobah''' (display name '''Premiere - Dagobah'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_dagobah</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]].

Decipher Deck Designs from mid 1997 (May through November, after Dagobah and before [[Cloud City]]) used this pool. Published tournament lists in this format are the [[1997 Kiffex Regionals]] and the [[1997 Sullust Regionals]]. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play">[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com], GEMP. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009095947/https://play.swccg.com/ Internet Archive].</ref> the same environment is <code>premiere_dagobah</code> (set ids 1&ndash;4 plus premium ids 101&ndash;105).
